summary: Add gh plate runner add|status|remove|doctor for ephemeral self-hosted runners on private repos with plate-local + OS labels (#1212).
migration_impact: Optional: adopters with a private repo can plan and register a local runner via gh plate runner; settings are stored in .agentic/runner.json.
migration_guidance: 1. Ensure the target repository is private; public repos are refused.
2. Run gh plate runner add OWNER/REPO (dry-run) then gh plate runner add OWNER/REPO --apply after review.
3. Use gh plate runner doctor to verify labels, token scopes, and isolation declarations.
4. Place actions-runner config.sh under .agentic/runner/ if automated configure should run on apply.
agent_notes: Never register runners on public repositories. add and remove default to dry-run; pass --apply for live changes. Mock gh API and subprocess in tests.
